skill.displayName: 低值易耗品与周转材料摊销核对（免费版）

llm.summary: This is a local Chinese accounting-ledger checker with a visible optional upsell flow, and I found no hidden networking, persistence, destructive behavior, or data exfiltration.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools Read and Bash are proportionate to reading a user-supplied local ledger file and running the bundled local checker; the code declares and inspection supports no network use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install script, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or external package loading was found; the runtime imports only local bundled files and Node standard modules.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most user-facing instructions are in Chinese, which matches the Chinese accounting ledger domain; the optional free/paid version prompt is prominent and user-directed, though commercially intrusive.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, scheduled tasks, hooks, credential access, privilege escalation, background workers, or persistent state changes were found in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is consistent: it checks low-value consumables and amortization ledger text using bundled Node.js code, reports deterministic findings with evidence, and clearly lists free checks and withheld paid checks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable running a local Chinese-language ledger checker and seeing an optional paid-version prompt. Do not provide unrelated sensitive documents, and treat the tool's output as a reconciliation aid rather than accounting, audit, tax, or payment advice.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file was present in this workspace and fully inspected, so the partial-inspection concern is not supported by the available artifact evidence.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language interface is expected for a checker built around Chinese accounting ledger headers and terminology; this is a usability/localization limitation, not evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: One code comment mentions pasted contract text, but the help text and engine require low-value consumables ledger headers and reject unrecognized material, so this is a minor documentation mismatch rather than a purpose mismatch in behavior.
